headline: Nepal PM Balendra Shah Begins Official State Visit To New Delhi
seoTitle: Nepal PM Balendra Shah Visits India
metaDescription: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah has arrived in New Delhi for his first official state visit to India to discuss bilateral relations and connectivity.
aiSummaryBullets: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah arrived in New Delhi on Sunday for his inaugural official visit to India.
External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar met with Prime Minister Shah to discuss strengthening cooperation in trade and connectivity.
The visit includes scheduled meetings with Prime Minister Narendra Modi to provide political direction for future bilateral relations.
aiContextParagraph: Prime Minister Balendra Shah of Nepal reached New Delhi on November 22 for his first official foreign visit since taking office in March 2026. Upon his arrival, the Prime Minister was greeted by the Indian Minister of State for Commerce and Industry, Jitin Prasada. During the trip, Balendra Shah has held preliminary discussions with Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar, who emphasized the significance of the friendship between the two nations. The official agenda for the state visit is focused on enhancing cooperation across various sectors, specifically highlighting energy and rail connectivity. The visit is expected to culminate in meetings with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, aimed at establishing a framework for bilateral ties in the coming years. A delegation accompanying the Prime Minister includes several key government officials and representatives from the business community to facilitate potential new agreements.
whyItIsViral: The event is being tracked by five independent news outlets with high coverage velocity following the Prime Minister's arrival in India.
